figures.caption: Figure 1: Hierarchical spatial encoding and multi-expert temporal reasoning framework.
Figure 2: Pipeline of dynamic EEG graph construction, hierarchical encoding, and the multi-expert transformer for subtype-aware and global EEG abnormality detection.

Figure 3: Mean connectivity (top) and ∆-connectivity (bottom) maps comparing normal and abnormal EEG subtypes. Distinct connectivity fingerprints particularly in focal slowing demonstrate spatially structured deviations from the normal baseline.
Figure 4: Post-hoc threshold analysis of the gated model. Abnormal recall versus decision threshold (left) and corresponding precision–recall trade-off (right).
Figure 5: Performance comparison across tuning, optimization, and final evaluation stages.
